story: As a content owner, I want to submit a translation request in one form so I stop chasing people over email.
successMetric: Time to submit a request is under 2 minutes.

story: As a content owner, I want to see each request's status so I know when content is ready.
successMetric: Any request's status is visible in 1 click from the dashboard.

story: As a reviewer, I want glossary terms flagged so translations stay consistent.
successMetric: 100% of approved glossary terms are flagged in submitted content.

story: As a translator, I want a screenshot with the text so my wording fits the context.
successMetric: Screenshot is visible alongside source text on the request detail view.

story: As a product owner, I want overdue requests highlighted and filterable by language so I can spot regional bottlenecks early.
successMetric: Overdue requests are visible at a glance from the dashboard.
